review_note: Retains fpqc locality ON THE SOURCE of flatness f:X→Y under covering Xi→X; both directions and absence of finite-presentation requirement.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ an fpqc covering. Then $f$ is flat if and only if each composite $f\circ a_i:X_i\to Y$ is flat. Thus flatness is fpqc-local on the source, without a finite-presentation assumption.
hypotheses: f:X→Y and {X_i→X} is an fpqc covering.
conclusions: Flatness of f is equivalent to flatness of each f∘a_i.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-flat-fpqc-local-source}
The property $\mathcal{P}(f)=$``$f$ is flat'' is fpqc local on the source.
